metadata.title: Urban Streetwear Portrait with High-Contrast Lighting

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot portrait of a male figure against a vibrant blue background. The subject wears a multi-colored camouflage durag and a matching open vest, accessorized with heavy jewelry and a white protective mask. The lighting is dramatic, featuring warm orange rim lights on the shoulders and arms to separate the subject from the cool blue environment.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the cool blue background and warm orange rim lighting on the subject's skin.
Repetition of camouflage patterns across the headwear and vest.
Central vertical alignment of the mask, jewelry, and torso tattoos.
Symmetry in the open vest framing the tattooed chest.
coreInvariants: Warm orange-yellow rim light on the subject's contours
Multi-colored camouflage pattern (blue, green, yellow, white)
Subject looking downward with a white mask

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally positioned, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame in a medium-shot scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white protective mask serves as the high-contrast focal point in the center of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright mask, moves upward to the patterned durag, then follows the orange rim light down the arms and vest.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper third of the frame, providing a clean, minimalist blue field.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep cerulean blue background providing a cool atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm orange and yellow rim lighting highlighting the subject's silhouette.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White mask and silver/diamond jewelry providing bright highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background and lighting, with high value contrast between the dark skin/tattoos and the bright white mask.

graphicDevices: Textural contrast between skin and fabric

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with tattoos on his chest and arms, wearing a multi-colored camouflage durag and an open camouflage vest. He should be wearing a white mask and heavy diamond chains. The background is a solid vibrant blue. Use strong orange rim lighting on his shoulders and arms.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a bold, sans-serif display font with a metallic or chrome texture to match the jewelry, placed in the upper negative space.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, vibrant blue?
Is there a distinct warm orange rim light on the subject's edges?
Is the camouflage pattern consistent across the durag and vest?
Is the subject looking down with a white mask as the central focus?

mustRedesign: Specific tattoo designs to avoid copyright issues
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the orange light does not bleed excessively into the blue background.
Check that the camouflage pattern looks like fabric, not a flat overlay.
Verify the mask is pure white and stands out as a focal point.
Confirm the tattoos appear integrated into the skin texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-saturation solid background with contrasting dual-tone lighting (cool fill, warm rim) to frame a subject wearing repetitive graphic patterns and high-value focal accessories.
